_meta.palantir_analog: Time-series + Streams + Live State in Palantir Foundry Ontology

Lane-current-status.consumer: all PR checks + ADR-0069 §11 lifecycle rule (b)

ICM-scaffold-locks.shape: memory records with agent_id + paths + window=open|closed

Grit-current-claims.source_path: grit status (CLI; backed by SQLite + worktree state)
Grit-current-claims.shape: active claims per agent + symbols + TTL
Grit-current-claims.known_failure_mode: SQLite FK error; fallback to scaffold-locks ICM

Audit-chain-event-stream.shape: per-tenant per-cell EVT-... events emitted from kinetic actions

honest_gaps: OpenTelemetry metric exporters declared in capability registry but not yet operational
Grit live state has known SQLite FK failure mode; ICM scaffold-lock fallback active
Auto-compute of consumer_count from graph edges (DRY drift detector) is planned, not operational

edges.object_description: On-disk per-account settings files rendered from templates (e.g., ~/.claude/settings.json per account)
edges.rationale: SettingsRenderer::render writes per-account files from template + AccountRow inputs. Bidirectional traceability: artifact -> generated artifact.

edges.object_description: Account list TOML files in registry/accounts/ (claude.toml, codex.toml, gemini.toml and their example variants)
edges.rationale: SettingsRenderer reads registry/accounts/*.toml at render time to produce per-account files. Data flow: accounts registry -> renderer -> per-account settings.

edges.object_description: SecretStorePort trait implemented by oya-intelligence-account-adapter-openbao; resolves sref://openbao/... references to actual secret values at render time
edges.rationale: SettingsRenderer calls SecretStorePort::resolve(sref) when populating secret fields in rendered per-account settings files. Port boundary: kernel trait -> adapter impl.
